steiner-1833.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner-1833.work: Die geometrischen Constructionen, ausgeführt mittelst der geraden Linie und Eines festen Kreises, als Lehrgegenstand auf höheren Unterrichts-Anstalten und zur praktischen Benutzung
steiner-1833.locus: §§ 1–22, [1]–[110]; Ostwald's Klassiker der exakten Wissenschaften Nr. 60, ed. A. J. von Oettingen (1895)
steiner-1833.note: Steiner's classic constructive treatise proving that every Euclidean ruler-and-compass construction can be executed with a straightedge alone given a single fixed circle and its center M.

steiner-1832.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner-1832.work: Systematische Entwickelung der Abhängigkeit geometrischer Gestalten von einander
steiner-1832.locus: Erster Theil (all published), xvi + 322 pp., 4 plates
steiner-1832.note: Steiner's foundational work establishing projective geometry systematically through projective ranges, pencils, and conic generation.

poncelet-1822.author: Jean-Victor Poncelet
poncelet-1822.work: Traité des propriétés projectives des figures
poncelet-1822.locus: Tome I, Section III, Chapitre III, §§ 351–358
poncelet-1822.note: First published announcement that all ruler-and-compass constructions can be executed using only a straightedge when one circle and its center are given in the plane.

mascheroni-1797.author: Lorenzo Mascheroni
mascheroni-1797.note: Classic compass-only treatise proving constructively that every Euclidean point-determination problem can be solved with the compass alone.

mohr-1672.author: Georg Mohr
mohr-1672.work: Euclides Danicus, Bestaende udi Too Deele
mohr-1672.locus: Parts I–II, 36 pp. (republished with German translation by J. Hjelmslev, Copenhagen: Høst & Søn, 1928)
mohr-1672.note: Earliest demonstration of compass-only constructibility, anticipating Mascheroni by 125 years.

lambert-1759.author: Johann Heinrich Lambert
lambert-1759.work: Freie Perspective, oder Anweisung, jeden perspektivischen Aufriß von freyen Stücken und ohne Grundriß zu verfertigen
lambert-1759.note: Pioneering investigation of ruler-only constructions in perspective drawing, cited by Steiner in § 2.

brianchon-1817.author: Charles Julien Brianchon
brianchon-1817.work: Application de la théorie des transversales
brianchon-1817.note: Transversal methods for harmonic poles and polars cited by Steiner in § 2.

hilbert-1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert-1899.locus: Siebentes Kapitel: Die geometrischen Konstruktionen auf Grund der Axiome I–IV (§§ 36–39)
hilbert-1899.note: Rigorous algebraic classification of geometric constructibility with straightedge and segment-transferrer (Eichmaß), contrasting the Pythagorean field with Steiner's Euclidean closure.

adler-1890.author: August Adler
adler-1890.work: Zur Theorie der Mascheronischen Constructionen / Theorie der geometrischen Konstruktionen
adler-1890.locus: Sitzungsberichte der Kaiserlichen Akademie der Wissenschaften in Wien, Math.-Naturwiss. Classe, Bd. 99; Sammlung Göschen Nr. 301 (1906)
adler-1890.publisher: K.-K. Hof- und Staatsdruckerei, Vienna / G. J. Göschen, Leipzig
adler-1890.note: Comparative theory of Mascheroni, Poncelet–Steiner, and Lemoine construction systems.

lemoine-1902.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1902.work: Géométrographie, ou Art des constructions géométriques
lemoine-1902.locus: Collection Scientia, Série Physico-Mathématique, n° 18 (pp. 74–85: Géométrographie Steinerienne)
lemoine-1902.note: Formalization of Steinerian geometrography measuring simplicity S and exactitude E of straightedge-only constructions.

euclid-elements.author: Euclid of Alexandria (trans. Sir Thomas L. Heath)
euclid-elements.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid-elements.locus: Books I–VI (Plane Geometry); GEOMETOR Digital Scriptorium Edition (geometor/euclid & geometor/elements)
euclid-elements.note: Standard axiomatic reference against which Steiner's constructive completeness is established.

pappus-synagoge.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus-synagoge.work: Synagoge (Mathematical Collection), Book VII: On the Domain of Analysis
pappus-synagoge.locus: ed. Friedrich Hultsch (1876–1878); ed. & trans. Alexander Jones (Springer, 1986)
pappus-synagoge.note: Classical source for cross-ratios, complete quadrilaterals, and harmonic division.

grueson-1825.author: Johann Philipp de Gruson (trans.)
grueson-1825.work: Des Herrn Abt L. Mascheroni Geometrie des Zirkels
grueson-1825.note: German translation of Mascheroni's La Geometria del Compasso studied by Steiner in Berlin.
